notes: Swarmstein (SWARMSTEIN) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 launched on Robinhood Chain and paired with IMD. The only deployed contract is SWARMSTEINToken (src/SWARMSTEINToken.sol): a self-contained EIP-20 implementation with no imports, no owner, no admin functions, no mint or burn function, no pause, no blacklist, no fee, no tax, no transfer limit, no proxy, no delegatecall and no selfdestruct; every parameter is a compile-time constant. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1e27 minor units at 18 decimals, the TOTAL_SUPPLY constant) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory; totalSupply() is a pure function returning that constant, so the supply can never change. There are no application contracts, so contracts is empty. Supply distribution is the factory's: it forwards the swarm's 10% to the launch's MerkleDistributor, seeds the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool against IMD (poolBps 9000) through the PoolManager at 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60, and sends any remainder to remainderTo. Nothing in the token reserves, sends or subtracts any allocation. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening sqrtPriceX96 from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2500 IMD for the whole supply), the token's supply and the deployed currency order.
